title: Traffic clone surge safeguards and credit leash
creator: Ayesha Kaur
description: Build a safe, tenant-aware traffic cloning pipeline that duplicates a controlled fraction of live requests to experimental model variants (clones) while enforcing per-tenant credit limits and surge protection. Unlike previous "shadow" approaches this work focuses on: 1) a clonable request envelope that preserves privacy boundaries (opaque-clone header), 2) an in-flight credit leash to stop clones for tenants exceeding budget, 3) an adaptive reservoir sampler that prioritizes traffic by business importance and request shape, and 4) a soft quarantine state for noisy tenants rather than global cutoffs. Deliverables: runtime controller + policy evaluator, charge-meter hook for billing, observability dashboard with clone-level diffs, and automated safety rollback signals tied to canary controller.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline can duplicate requests to a clone variant at configurable sampling rates per-tenant and per-route
Per-tenant credit meter prevents more than configured token-budget (example: 10k tokens/day) from reaching cloned model cluster
Adaptive reservoir sampler reduces clone rate for high-cost long-sequence requests automatically when budget approaches threshold
Opaque-clone header prevents persistent identifiers from being sent to clones; raw tenant PII removed in transformed clone envelope
Clone failures (timeout/error %) above threshold automatically flag tenant for soft quarantine and notify on-call
End-to-end tests and load tests proving 0.5% median latency delta for production path when cloning at 20% system-wide sampling
Dashboard visualizes per-tenant clone spend, delta-latency, delta-quality metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/perplexity proxy) and can trigger auto-rollback rules
comments: 2026-02-11 - Ayesha Kaur: Kickoff spike completed. Validated feasibility of in-flight credit meter using token accounting hooks from billing. Prototype uses a leaky-bucket token store in Redis; acceptable QPS for 1M tenants simulation.

2026-02-18 - Jared Cole: Implemented adaptive reservoir sampler POC. Chose reservoir over stratified sampling to prioritize rare but high-value request types. Trade-off: minor sampling bias for long-tail metrics; will document in design notes.
2026-02-25 - Marta Villanueva (PM): Reviewed requirements. Requested explicit privacy checklist for clone envelope (KMS, masking rules). Added action item to coordinate with Security.

2026-03-03 - Ling Chen (Security): Reviewed headroom for KMS integration. Recommended encrypting clone payloads at rest and ensuring index-free logs for clones. Assigned security_review_required flag.

2026-03-07 - Jared Cole: Implemented credit leash release flow and soft-quarantine state. Behavior: when tenant exceeds budget, future requests are cloned to a sandbox-only probe (no billing) and telemetry flags tenant for ops review.
2026-03-11 - Design review (internal): UX asks to expose per-tenant 'leash remaining' as an normalized percent and timestamp-to-drain. Added to dashboard backlog.

2026-03-12 - Ayesha Kaur: Load tests run against staging with synthetic 50% clone at 2k RPS for 2 hours. Observed 0.7% median increase in tail p95; decision: implement in-path header-based bypass to keep critical low-latency routes unaffected by cloning.

2026-03-12 - Follow-up: Create canary-controller hook that rolls back clone configuration when clone_error_rate > 0.5% and delta-quality > configured threshold for 15m window. Added acceptance criteria and will wire to rollouts service.
rollout_strategy: Start with platform-internal tenants at 1% sampling, expand to low-risk customer cohorts using adaptive-sampling and per-tenant credit leash. Auto-rollback triggers via canary-controller on error/quality regressions.
